_about: The titles. A title is a word of its time (docs/DESIGN.md, Exams and titles): in Era 1 the messenger of the Hùng King names the child người tài (print: the title goes into the notebook as a print, with no stele). The scholar titles, based on the old exam system (thi Hương, thi Hội, thi Đình), come with the exams of Văn Miếu, from chapter 7 (the Lý). A pass of the exam of an era gives the title of that era. Trạng nguyên needs a pass in all five eras. An exam with a title uses the skills of the era of that title. examiners: the place and the person of the exams, by chapter (from: the first chapter; speaker: the portrait and the voice; placeKey: the name of the place; lines: the prefix of the lines of the person, as exam (Văn Miếu) or exam.messenger).
